<article title="Refund timelines">
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. Your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

If you chose store credit, it appears in your account as soon as the return is checked in, usually the same day.

If more than 15 business days have passed since the carrier delivered your return to us and no refund has appeared, contact us with your order number and we will check the return with our warehouse.

</article>

<request>
refund not received
i sent back my order three weeks ago and the carrier shows it delivered to you, but no refund has appeared on my card.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Diego,

Thanks for reaching out. Since it's been three weeks since delivery, I'd like to help you get this sorted. According to our process, refunds to the original payment method take up to five business days after arrival at our warehouse, plus three to ten additional business days for your bank to process.

However, since more than 15 business days have passed, I recommend contacting us directly with your order number so our warehouse team can check on your return status.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
